title: Data Subject Rights Channel
description: A contact channel for data-subject rights requests: the rights it handles, a URL, an email address, or both, and its languages and countries.

url.description: HTTPS URL for submitting the rights request.

email.description: Email address for submitting the rights request.

languages.description: BCP 47 language tags supported by this channel.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 countries this channel serves, when the provider routes rights by country.
